scripts.generatepdf: node create-tex.mjs --lang=en && mkdir -p dist && if command -v tectonic >/dev/null; then tectonic --outdir dist christoffer-nilsson-en.tex; else pdflatex -output-directory dist christoffer-nilsson-en.tex; fi
scripts.generatepdf:sv: node create-tex.mjs --lang=sv && mkdir -p dist && if command -v tectonic >/dev/null; then tectonic --outdir dist christoffer-nilsson-sv.tex; else pdflatex -output-directory dist christoffer-nilsson-sv.tex; fi
scripts.predeploy: npm run build && npm run generatepdf && npm run generatepdf:sv
